component.name: PlaylistTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "loadPlaylist" end sub
sub loadPlaylist() m.top.errorMessage = "" response = fetchText(m.top.uri) if response.error <> "" m.top.errorMessage = response.error return end if
playlistType = LCase(m.top.playlistType) if playlistType = "" playlistType = extensionFromUrl(m.top.uri) end if
if playlistType = "server-random" playlist = parseServerPlaylist(response.body) else if playlistType = "pls" playlist = parsePls(response.body) else if playlistType = "m3u" or playlistType = "m3u8" playlist = parseM3u(response.body) else m.top.errorMessage = "Unsupported playlist type: " + playlistType return end if
if playlist.getChildCount() = 0 m.top.errorMessage = "The selected channel playlist contains no playable entries." return end if m.top.playlist = playlist end sub
function fetchText(uri as string) as object transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port)
if not transfer.asyncGetToString() return { body: "", error: "The playlist request could not be started." } end if
timeoutSeconds = m.top.timeoutSeconds if timeoutSeconds <= 0 then timeoutSeconds = 15 event = wait(timeoutSeconds * 1000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The playlist server did not respond within " + timeoutSeconds.toStr() + " seconds." } end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The playlist server returned an unexpected network event." } end if
body = event.getString() code = event.getResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 return { body: "", error: "Playlist request failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." } end if if body = "" then return { body: "", error: "The playlist response was empty." } return { body: body, error: "" } end function
function parseServerPlaylist(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") envelope = ParseJson(text) if type(envelope) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return playlist if not envelope.doesExist("items") or type(envelope.items) <> "roArray" then return playlist
for index = 0 to envelope.items.count() - 1 item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") serverItem = envelope.items[index] if m.top.browseMode resolverIndex = index if type(serverItem) = "roAssociativeArray" and serverItem.doesExist("index") indexType = type(serverItem.index) if indexType = "Integer" resolverIndex = serverItem.index else if indexType = "roString" or indexType = "String" resolverIndex = serverItem.index.toInt() end if end if item.addFields({ resolveUrl: ensureTrailingSlash(m.top.resolverUri) + resolverIndex.toStr() metadataLength: jsonInteger(serverItem, "length", -1) }) item.title = jsonString(serverItem, "title") item.url = jsonString(serverItem, "url") item.description = jsonString(serverItem, "description") if item.title = "" then item.title = item.url if item.description = "" then item.description = jsonString(envelope, "channel") else item.addFields({ resolveUrl: m.top.resolverUri, metadataLength: -1 }) item.title = "Shuffled program " + (index + 1).toStr() end if item.streamFormat = jsonString(serverItem, "streamFormat") item.HDPosterUrl = jsonThumbnail(serverItem) item.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" playlist.appendChild(item) end for return playlist end function
function jsonString(value as dynamic, key as string) as string if type(value) <> "roAssociativeArray" or not value.doesExist(key) then return "" fieldType = type(value[key]) if fieldType = "roString" or fieldType = "String" return value[key].trim() end if return "" end function
function jsonInteger(value as dynamic, key as string, fallback as integer) as integer if type(value) <> "roAssociativeArray" or not value.doesExist(key) then return fallback fieldType = type(value[key]) if fieldType = "Integer" or fieldType = "LongInteger" or fieldType = "Float" or fieldType = "Double" return int(value[key]) end if return fallback end function
function jsonThumbnail(value as dynamic) as string if type(value) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return "" candidates = [] keys = [ "thumbs", "thumbnails" ] for each key in keys if value.doesExist(key) and type(value[key]) = "roArray" for each thumbnail in value[key] thumbnailType = type(thumbnail) if (thumbnailType = "roString" or thumbnailType = "String") and thumbnail.trim() <> "" candidates.push(thumbnail.trim()) end if end for else if value.doesExist(key) and (type(value[key]) = "roString" or type(value[key]) = "String") if value[key].trim() <> "" then candidates.push(value[key].trim()) end if end for if candidates.count() = 0 thumbnail = jsonString(value, "thumbnail") if thumbnail <> "" then candidates.push(thumbnail) end if if candidates.count() = 0 then return "" index = 0 if candidates.count() > 1 then index = Rnd(candidates.count()) - 1 return resolveEntryUrl(candidates[index]) end function
function ensureTrailingSlash(value as string) as string if value = "" or value.right(1) = "/" then return value return value + "/" end function
function parseM3u(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") pendingTitle = "" pendingLength = -1 lines = text.split(chr(10)) for each rawLine in lines line = cleanLine(rawLine) if UCase(line.left(8)) = "#EXTINF:" comma = instr(1, line, ",") if comma > 0 pendingTitle = line.mid(comma) pendingLength = line.mid(8, comma - 9).toInt() end if else if line <> "" and line.left(1) <> "#" appendEntry(playlist, line, pendingTitle, "", "", pendingLength) pendingTitle = "" pendingLength = -1 end if end for return playlist end function
function parsePls(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") files = {} titles = {} descriptions = {} lengths = {} commentTitles = {} commentDescriptions = {} commentThumbnails = {} commentLengths = {} commentDurationLengths = {} maxIndex = 0
for each rawLine in text.split(chr(10)) line = cleanLine(rawLine) equalsAt = instr(1, line, "=") if equalsAt > 1 key = LCase(line.left(equalsAt - 1)) value = line.mid(equalsAt) if key.left(4) = "file" index = key.mid(4).toInt() files[index.toStr()] = value if index > maxIndex then maxIndex = index else if key.left(5) = "title" index = key.mid(5).toInt() titles[index.toStr()] = value else if key.left(11) = "description" index = key.mid(11).toInt() descriptions[index.toStr()] = value else if key.left(6) = "length" index = key.mid(6).toInt() lengths[index.toStr()] = value.toInt() else if key.left(7) = "comment" and key.right(9) = "_duration" index = key.left(key.len() - 9).mid(7).toInt() duration = parseDuration(value) if duration >= 0 then commentDurationLengths[index.toStr()] = duration else if key.left(7) = "comment" index = key.mid(7).toInt() itemKey = index.toStr() commentTitle = commentField(value, "Title: ", " | Duration: ") commentDescription = commentField(value, " | Description: ", " | Thumbnail: ") commentThumbnail = commentField(value, " | Thumbnail: ", "") commentLength = parseDuration(commentField(value, " | Duration: ", " | Description: ")) if commentTitle <> "" then commentTitles[itemKey] = commentTitle if commentDescription <> "" then commentDescriptions[itemKey] = commentDescription if commentThumbnail <> "" then commentThumbnails[itemKey] = commentThumbnail if commentLength >= 0 then commentLengths[itemKey] = commentLength end if end if end for
for index = 1 to maxIndex key = index.toStr() if files.doesExist(key) title = "" if titles.doesExist(key) then title = titles[key] if title = "" and commentTitles.doesExist(key) then title = commentTitles[key] description = "" if descriptions.doesExist(key) then description = descriptions[key] if description = "" and commentDescriptions.doesExist(key) then description = commentDescriptions[key] thumbnail = "" if commentThumbnails.doesExist(key) then thumbnail = commentThumbnails[key] length = -1 if lengths.doesExist(key) length = lengths[key] else if commentDurationLengths.doesExist(key) length = commentDurationLengths[key] else if commentLengths.doesExist(key) length = commentLengths[key] end if appendEntry(playlist, files[key], title, description, thumbnail, length) end if end for return playlist end function
function commentField(comment as string, label as string, nextLabel as string) as string startAt = instr(1, comment, label) if startAt = 0 then return "" valueAt = startAt + label.len() if nextLabel = "" then return comment.mid(valueAt - 1).trim() endAt = instr(valueAt, comment, nextLabel) if endAt = 0 then return comment.mid(valueAt - 1).trim() return comment.mid(valueAt - 1, endAt - valueAt).trim() end function
function parseDuration(value as string) as integer if value = "" or LCase(value) = "unknown" then return -1 parts = value.split(":") if parts.count() = 2 if not isDigits(parts[0]) or not isDigits(parts[1]) then return -1 minutes = parts[0].toInt() seconds = parts[1].toInt() if seconds >= 60 then return -1 return minutes * 60 + seconds else if parts.count() = 3 if not isDigits(parts[0]) or not isDigits(parts[1]) or not isDigits(parts[2]) then return -1 hours = parts[0].toInt() minutes = parts[1].toInt() seconds = parts[2].toInt() if minutes >= 60 or seconds >= 60 then return -1 return hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds end if return -1 end function
function isDigits(value as string) as boolean if value = "" then return false for index = 0 to value.len() - 1 character = value.mid(index, 1) if character < "0" or character > "9" then return false end for return true end function
sub appendEntry(parent as object, url as string, title as string, description as string, thumbnail as string, length as integer) item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.addFields({ resolveUrl: "", metadataLength: length }) item.url = resolveEntryUrl(url) item.title = title if item.title = "" then item.title = "Playlist item " + (parent.getChildCount() + 1).toStr() item.description = description if thumbnail <> "" then item.HDPosterUrl = resolveEntryUrl(thumbnail) item.streamFormat = mediaFormat(url) item.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" parent.appendChild(item) end sub
function resolveEntryUrl(value as string) as string entryUrl = cleanLine(value) lowerUrl = LCase(entryUrl) if lowerUrl.left(7) = "http://" or lowerUrl.left(8) = "https://" then return entryUrl
baseUrl = m.top.uri if entryUrl.left(2) = "//" schemeParts = baseUrl.split(":") if schemeParts.count() > 0 then return schemeParts[0] + ":" + entryUrl end if
baseParts = baseUrl.split("/") if entryUrl.left(1) = "/" and baseParts.count() >= 3 return baseParts[0] + "//" + baseParts[2] + entryUrl end if
queryAt = instr(1, baseUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then baseUrl = baseUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, baseUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then baseUrl = baseUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) for index = len(baseUrl) to 1 step -1 if baseUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "/" return baseUrl.left(index) + entryUrl end if end for return entryUrl end function
function mediaFormat(url as string) as string extension = extensionFromUrl(url) if extension = "m3u8" then return "hls" if extension = "mpd" then return "dash" if extension = "ism" or extension = "isml" then return "ism" if extension = "m4a" then return "mp4" if extension = "wav" then return "pcm" if extension = "" then return "mp4" return extension end function
function extensionFromUrl(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) dotAt = 0 for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 if cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "." dotAt = index exit for end if if cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "/" then exit for end for if dotAt = 0 then return "" return LCase(cleanUrl.mid(dotAt)) end function
function cleanLine(value as string) as string return value.replace(chr(13), "").trim() end function
